desc: Implement the `count(n)` helper function that iterates through all possible digit sums $S$ from 1 to 81.
Inside `count(n)`, define a recursive DP function (with memoization) that takes arguments `(index, tight, current_sum, current_prod_mod_S)` to count valid numbers for the current $S$.
Ensure the DP handles the base case (end of digits) by checking if `current_sum == S` and `current_prod_mod_S == 0`.
Implement the main `beautifulNumbers` method to compute `count(r) - count(l - 1)` and return the result.
Test logic mentally with Example 1 (10-20) and Example 2 (1-15) to ensure edge cases like single digits and zeros are handled correctly.
